topic.readerProblem: Decide between Profound, a dedicated AI visibility platform, and Semrush's AI Visibility Toolkit, an add-on to an all-in-one SEO suite, without hands-on reviews.
topic.connection: Helps an AEOeye reader choose between ongoing monitoring tools and a one-off audit, and shows how to check whether AI engines already name them before paying.

assessment: The page compares Profound and Semrush using only each vendor's own pricing pages, knowledge-base articles and help center, fetched 2026-10-03. It gives a clear verdict (Semrush as the default for small and mid-market teams, Profound when AI visibility is a staffed enterprise channel), a feature table, our own per-prompt arithmetic, and a warning that the two visibility scores are not comparable. It flags documentation inconsistencies on Semrush's side (engine list, trial wording) and does not claim hands-on use, accuracy testing, or a Profound Enterprise price.

sources.supports: AI Visibility Base $99/mo per domain billed annually, 25 daily prompts, 1 Brand Performance domain, mentions from ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini and Perplexity, 300 reports a day, users from $45/mo, Enterprise custom.

SEO + AI Search plans: Starter $199 ($165.17 annual) 50 prompts, Pro+ $299 ($248.17) 100 prompts, Advanced $549 ($455.67) 200 prompts, SEO limits, seven-day free trial wording. Amounts confirmed in the raw HTML.
Toolkit report list, built with SMBs, agencies and mid-market in mind, AI Search Site Audit for up to 100 pages, 10 CSV exports daily, no free trial for the toolkit, AI Visibility Score definition.
AI Search Site Audit flags missing llms.txt files and pages blocking key AI bots in robots.txt.
Prompt Tracking runs custom prompts daily on ChatGPT Search, Google AI Mode and Gemini.
Visibility Overview uses a database of 317M+ AI queries, refreshed daily.
Profound free 7-day Trial (50 prompts daily, 3 engines, fixed prompts, no exports or history) and quote-only Enterprise (up to 9 engines, all-time history, CSV/JSON, API, SSO).
Profound's definitions of visibility score, share of voice, citations, sentiment and FactCheck.
Under 1-in-100 chance that ChatGPT or Google's AI repeats the same brand list in two responses.

checks: Writer (Sonnet): fetched Semrush's AI Visibility pricing page, main pricing page and three knowledge-base articles on 2026-10-03, confirmed the plan amounts ($99, $199/$165.17, $299/$248.17, $549/$455.67) in the raw HTML, and found the old knowledge-base URL cited elsewhere (/kb/1494-...) now returns 404, so the current /kb/1493-, 1496-, 1503- and 1596- pages are used instead.

Writer (Sonnet): recomputed the per-prompt figures ($99/25 = $3.96, $165.17/50 = $3.30, $248.17/100 = $2.48, $455.67/200 = $2.28) and labelled them as our arithmetic on annual-billed prices that include SEO tools in the three larger plans.

Writer (Sonnet): fetched Profound's pricing page and help center the same day and compared the two vendors' score definitions side by side before stating they are not comparable; flagged Semrush's inconsistencies (Perplexity on pricing page but not in Prompt Tracking guide; 'no free trial' in the knowledge base vs a seven-day trial on the pricing page) instead of picking one.

Writer (Sonnet): used AEOeye's crawler access study numbers (1 of 193 SaaS sites vs 27 of 38 publishers blocking any AI retrieval bot, n=384 robots.txt files) with their denominators; did not claim anything about semrush.com's own site because it is not in the sample.
